name: ACC Community Pets Program
region_note: BEHAVIOR SUPPORT (a common, workable reason owners seek help)
notes:
CommunityPets@nycacc.org - (212) 788-4000. Free/reduced vet referrals, spay/neuter, deferred/managed intake, and help during a crisis so a cat can stay in its home. Ask about the surrender-prevention questionnaire; a counselor follows up.

free dog training (in person or via Zoom/FaceTime) through partner trainers; behavior guides at nycacc.org/services/behavior-resources. Contact: admissions@nycacc.org, (212) 788-4000.

ACC's Community Pets Program provides free resources to help owners care for their dogs. Contact via nycacc.org/programs/community-resources or ACC (212) 788-4000.
